name: Prepare a handmade furniture listing
goal: Prepare Etsy and Shopify drafts from maker-supplied facts and completed-sale comparisons. A draft is not published until the owner reviews it and manually publishes it.

config.prompt: Your step: Review the Etsy and Shopify listing drafts, source-linked completed sales, price and photos. Approve only if the details are correct. Approval authorizes you to publish manually; Glacier will not publish or contact either platform.

config.template:
The owner approved review of the prepared draft in run {run}. The listing remains unpublished; copy the reviewed content to Etsy and Shopify manually.

{summary}

The listing draft was not approved in run {run}. No listing was published.

{summary}

config.prompt: Your step: save maker-confirmed product facts and completed-sale comparables at $GLACIER_HOME/ventures/carpenter-goods/incoming/product.json and $GLACIER_HOME/ventures/carpenter-goods/incoming/comparables.json. Include product name, materials, dimensions, price, photos, and source links. Return and approve after both files are ready. Glacier will not publish the listing.

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import json,os,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures'/'carpenter-goods'/'drafts'/'listing.json'; d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert d['published'] is False and d['etsy']['title'] and d['shopify']['title'] and d['result'] in ('match', 'uncertain — please check')"
